claim_boundary: Exploratory, planned after the main study's test results were known. Every ranking and subset was chosen from session 1 only; a participant's population (pop-*) montage comes from the other eight participants' session-1 rankings and never uses that participant's data. Session-2 accuracies are not a prospective test and do not replace the frozen final configuration.

bootstrap.method: participant-level bootstrap of paired differences, percentile interval
